promptSet.title: Neon Times Square Night Billboard Photograph
promptSet.prompt: Cinematic night street photography of New York City Times Square in light rain. Massive glowing LED billboard high on a skyscraper displaying a striking portrait of the subject with neon text overlay. Wet asphalt reflecting vibrant yellow taxi lights and magenta neon signs, 35mm street photography.
instructions: Enter this prompt into Midjourney v6 or ChatGPT Images.
Upload your reference subject image or branding logo.
Render with high aesthetic weight for ultra-realistic wet-street reflections.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Atmospheric rainy night photograph with glowing Times Square billboards reflecting in puddles.
